g.text: Jena CPU2 fresh-process cost: median, p90 and observed trial range
Circle: median; triangle: p90; line: min-max timed-trial spread, not a confidence interval. Failed/missing costs have no numeric point.
Same CPU2 protocol: warmup 10 / timed 20 / separate stage 20 / row microbatch 128 / checkpoint inputs off. No speedup ratios.
Different architectures and learned refit lengths; no equal-parameter or equal-compute claim. Post-T, one seed; no CI.
